  "practices": [
    {"id": "p-bp1", "text": "Provide metadata for both human users and computer applications.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide metadata for both human users and computer applications.", "location": "8.2 Metadata"},
    {"id": "p-bp2", "text": "Provide metadata that describes the overall features of datasets and distributions.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide metadata that describes the overall features of datasets and distributions.", "location": "8.2 Metadata"},
    {"id": "p-bp3", "text": "Provide metadata that describes the schema and internal structure of a distribution.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide metadata that describes the schema and internal structure of a distribution.", "location": "8.2 Metadata"},
    {"id": "p-bp4", "text": "Provide a link to or copy of the license agreement that controls use of the data.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide a link to or copy of the license agreement that controls use of the data.", "location": "8.3 Data Licenses"},
    {"id": "p-bp5", "text": "Provide complete information about the origins of the data and any changes you have made.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide complete information about the origins of the data and any changes you have made.", "location": "8.4 Data Provenance"},
    {"id": "p-bp6", "text": "Provide information about data quality and fitness for particular purposes.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide information about data quality and fitness for particular purposes.", "location": "8.5 Data Quality"},
    {"id": "p-bp7", "text": "Assign and indicate a version number or date for each dataset.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Assign and indicate a version number or date for each dataset.", "location": "8.6 Data Versioning"},
    {"id": "p-bp8", "text": "Provide a complete version history that explains the changes made in each version.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Provide a complete version history that explains the changes made in each version.", "location": "8.6 Data Versioning"},
    {"id": "p-bp9", "text": "Identify each dataset by a carefully chosen, persistent URI.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Identify each dataset by a carefully chosen, persistent URI.", "location": "8.7 Data Identifiers"},
    {"id": "p-bp10", "text": "Reuse other people's URIs as identifiers within datasets where possible.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Reuse other people's URIs as identifiers within datasets where possible.", "location": "8.7 Data Identifiers"},
    {"id": "p-bp11", "text": "Assign URIs to individual versions of datasets as well as to the overall series.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Assign URIs to individual versions of datasets as well as to the overall series.", "location": "8.7 Data Identifiers"},
    {"id": "p-bp12", "text": "Make data available in a machine-readable, standardized data format that is well suited to its intended or potential use.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Make data available in a machine-readable, standardized data format that is well suited to its intended or potential use.", "location": "8.8 Data Formats"},
    {"id": "p-bp13", "text": "Use locale-neutral data structures and values, or, where that is not possible, provide metadata about the locale used by data values.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Use locale-neutral data structures and values, or, where that is not possible, provide metadata about the locale used by data values.", "location": "8.8 Data Formats"},
    {"id": "p-bp14", "text": "Make data available in multiple formats when more than one format suits its intended or potential use.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Make data available in multiple formats when more than one format suits its intended or potential use.", "location": "8.8 Data Formats"},
    {"id": "p-bp15", "text": "Use terms from shared vocabularies, preferably standardized ones, to encode data and metadata.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Use terms from shared vocabularies, preferably standardized ones, to encode data and metadata.", "location": "8.9 Data Vocabularies"},
    {"id": "p-bp16", "text": "Opt for a level of formal semantics that fits both data and the most likely applications.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Opt for a level of formal semantics that fits both data and the most likely applications.", "location": "8.9 Data Vocabularies"},
    {"id": "p-bp17", "text": "Enable consumers to retrieve the full dataset with a single request.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "bulk_file", "grounding_span": "Enable consumers to retrieve the full dataset with a single request.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp18", "text": "If your dataset is large, enable users and applications to readily work with useful subsets of your data.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "If your dataset is large, enable users and applications to readily work with useful subsets of your data.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp19", "text": "Use content negotiation in addition to file extensions for serving data available in multiple formats.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "Use content negotiation in addition to file extensions for serving data available in multiple formats.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp20", "text": "When data is produced in real time, make it available on the Web in real time or near real-time.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "When data is produced in real time, make it available on the Web in real time or near real-time.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp21", "text": "Make data available in an up-to-date manner, and make the update frequency explicit.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Make data available in an up-to-date manner, and make the update frequency explicit.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp22", "text": "For data that is not available, provide an explanation about how the data can be accessed and who can access it.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "advisory", "grounding_span": "For data that is not available, provide an explanation about how the data can be accessed and who can access it.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp23", "text": "Offer an API to serve data if you have the resources to do so.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "Offer an API to serve data if you have the resources to do so.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp24", "text": "When designing APIs, use an architectural style that is founded on the technologies of the Web itself.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "When designing APIs, use an architectural style that is founded on the technologies of the Web itself.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp25", "text": "Provide complete information on the Web about your API. Update documentation as you add features or make changes.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "Provide complete information on the Web about your API. Update documentation as you add features or make changes.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp26", "text": "Avoid changes to your API that break client code, and communicate any changes in your API to your developers when evolution happens.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "Avoid changes to your API that break client code, and communicate any changes in your API to your developers when evolution happens.", "location": "8.10 Data Access"},
    {"id": "p-bp27", "text": "When removing data from the Web, preserve the identifier and provide information about the archived resource.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "When removing data from the Web, preserve the identifier and provide information about the archived resource.", "location": "8.11 Data Preservation"},
    {"id": "p-bp28", "text": "Assess the coverage of a dataset prior to its preservation.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Assess the coverage of a dataset prior to its preservation.", "location": "8.11 Data Preservation"},
    {"id": "p-bp29", "text": "Provide a readily discoverable means for consumers to offer feedback.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "Provide a readily discoverable means for consumers to offer feedback.", "location": "8.12 Feedback"},
    {"id": "p-bp30", "text": "Make consumer feedback about datasets and distributions publicly available.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "Make consumer feedback about datasets and distributions publicly available.", "location": "8.12 Feedback"},
    {"id": "p-bp31", "text": "Enrich your data by generating new data when doing so will enhance its value.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Enrich your data by generating new data when doing so will enhance its value.", "location": "8.13 Data Enrichment"},
    {"id": "p-bp32", "text": "Enrich data by presenting it in complementary, immediately informative ways, such as visualizations, tables, Web applications, or summaries.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "Enrich data by presenting it in complementary, immediately informative ways, such as visualizations, tables, Web applications, or summaries.", "location": "8.13 Data Enrichment"},
    {"id": "p-bp33", "text": "Let the original publisher know when you are reusing their data.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "advisory", "grounding_span": "Let the original publisher know when you are reusing their data.", "location": "8.14 Republication"},
    {"id": "p-bp34", "text": "Find and follow the licensing requirements from the original publisher of the dataset.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "advisory", "grounding_span": "Find and follow the licensing requirements from the original publisher of the dataset.", "location": "8.14 Republication"},
    {"id": "p-bp35", "text": "Acknowledge the source of your data in metadata. If you provide a user interface, include the citation visibly in the interface.", "as_of_date": "2017-01-31", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "Acknowledge the source of your data in metadata. If you provide a user interface, include the citation visibly in the interface.", "location": "8.14 Republication"}
